create_InitialGuessMode: create an InitialGuessMode enum to specify initial guess modes for iterative solvers
use_InitialGuessMode_X_OLD: use InitialGuessMode.X_OLD to initialize x_new equal to x_old for iterative solvers
use_InitialGuessMode_LINEAR: use InitialGuessMode.LINEAR to use the linear solver to guess x_new for iterative solvers
select_InitialGuessMode: select an InitialGuessMode enum value to configure initial guess behavior in iterative solvers
compare_InitialGuessMode: compare InitialGuessMode enum values X_OLD and LINEAR for iterative solver initial guess strategies
